title: Localization & Internationalization (i18n)
subtitle: High-performance, lazy-loaded, type-safe localization with seamless RTL & LTR support.

features.title: Core Architecture Highlights
features.lazyLoading: Lazy Loaded Chunks: Only the active language bundle is loaded at startup. Extra languages are fetched on demand.
features.typeSafety: Full TypeScript Autocompletion: Translation keys are validated by the compiler via schema augmentation.
features.rtlSupport: Dynamic RTL / LTR: Automatically synchronizes document direction, typography, and layout.
features.dayjsSync: Dayjs & Intl Integration: Date, time, relative time, and currency formats update dynamically.

interpolation.title: Dynamic Interpolation & Variables
interpolation.greeting: Hello, {name}! Welcome back to your workspace.
interpolation.userStats: You have {count} unread notifications and {points} loyalty points.

pluralization.title: Pluralization Support
pluralization.description: Vue i18n handles singular, zero, and plural forms cleanly:
